items.text: This patch includes completed French and Spanish translations for Omenroad, a good collection of bugfixes, and some small changes.
As we announced, we won't be developing new content, but will continue to support the game and fix bugs.
1.16+543 Omenroad Hotfix
French and Spanish Omenroad fully translated!
Three new tidings
Two additional phases added to music in A Walk in the Unlight final fight
Some lines added to A Walk in the Unlight to acknowledge soulmate heroes
Can now use entangle on allies that can't be knocked back
Added text feedback when Ode to the Unyielding prevents death
Adjusted weighting on several tidings
Adjusted tongue whip description
Various translation adjustments

Added a warning message that shows up if the player account has no legacy or legacy backup file, but does have a save game. This is to try and help with an uncommon issue (probably with Steam Cloud?) where the legacy and legacy backup files get deleted for some reason
Fixed bug with Overwhelming Monstrosity achievement
Fixed bug where non-family heroes were showing up as family
Fixed bug where "Save and Quit" option could be chosen in places where "Save" option is disabled, causing unexpected behavior
Fixed bug where in-game change notes only showed up in English and Chinese
Fixed bug where Terror's Talons could move immune to knockback enemies
Fixed bug where legacy locked soulmates or rivals caused weird behavior in A Walk in the Unlight (legacy relationship lock will now be ignored, other than the new lines that were added)
Fixed bug where The Glorysword Clayn attack wasn't marked as melee
Fixed bug where Omenroad results could be cut off with lots of abilities
Fixed bug with Arrow of Anywise cover
Fixed several small comic bugs in A Walk in the Unlight
Fixed bug where campaigns could get stuck at "Constructing Mission"
Fixed bug where Luthin duplicates didn't have correct golden shields
Fixed bug where flashcone kills wouldn't increase hero kill counter
Fixed bug where Sunglory Spaulders didn't grant additional damage
Fixed bug where Omenfry Skillet dealt less damage than intended
Fixed bug where audio wouldn't play on native linux version
Butler with "Tend the Coals" region now deals damage at start of its own turn, rather than at the start of the player turn
Netherowl upgrade can now be acquired/used outside of Omenroad campaign
Ambush with AOE attacks (like cone of fire) will no longer damage allies
Archery counterattacks with AOE attacks (like cone of fire) can now happen through allies without damaging them (previously, allies would prevent Archery)
Fixed bug where Sentinel with long reach could sometimes jump to a spot where hero LOS is blocked by enemy
Fixed bug where stun wouldn't interrupt enemy movement
Fixed bug where lover's vengeance and Ode to Righteous Wrath weren't applied to flanking foes
Fixed bug where Omenroad gem shrine might not show the correct options
Fixed controller binding bug on "Next" button during credits
Fixed bug where Skeletal body would not show up for theme skins if you didn't have a skeletal head
Fixed bugs where Protector, elmish jealousy, and splinterskin against an enemy that charged (like a Raid Knight) would cause the enemy to die on their initial tile instead of their destination
Fixed bugs with controller navigation for interfusion where sometimes you couldn't move the cursor off of multi-tile or diagonal scenery
Fixed bug where escape key would close Legacy Browser while a character sheet was open
Fixed some rare crashes
Submitting Steam Workshop mods now does not upload files and folders starting with a dot (e.g. ".git")
Tools: Fixed bug with skinColorPaletteOverride aspect
Tools: Added requireAspects to HistoryLine
Tools: Support for hiragana and katakana Japanese characters (for translation mods)
Tools: Added WAS_ATTACKED_EARLY effect trigger
Tools: Added comicScaleMult aspect, which can be used to make units appear larger or smaller in comics
Tools: History entries with ids ending in "_customizationEntry" are now treated as customization entries in addition to entries with id 500-599
Tools: Added specificHumanBaseId field to entity query and scenario roster slot, to allow creating a unit based on a specific base history id other than humanBase.001
Tools: NPCs that use "looksSimilarTo" will use the same specificHumanBase id as their target
Tools: If ContentEditor fails to save, now logs what the error was
Tools: Added requireOwnerAspects and forbidOwnerAspects to items
Tools: Added support for Thai translation mods
